items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: When I was a child, I could remember his playing with John Robichaux's orchestra.

ctx.x: One kind of thing a long time ago when we think of him as being one of the pioneers, one of the old men in jazz, but he wasn't old at all.
No, he wasn't an old man. No. When I was a child, I could remember his playing with John Robichaux's orchestra. Oh, yes.
I was going to ask. I knew that he'd heard he played with them and I've had pictures of him playing on the boat with Fate Marable.
